name: Research tools
title: Research tools | Amplifier Smart Tools
description: Two tools for working with evidence. Deep Research investigates open questions. Fact Check examines specific claims. Both keep sources and results you can return to.
caption: Workflow illustration.
flow_title: Two starting points. One evidence trail.
flow_intro: Two tools for working with evidence. Deep Research investigates open questions. Fact Check examines specific claims. Both keep sources and results you can return to.
steps: Use Deep Research when you need to find out what is known.
Use Fact Check when you have an assertion to test against evidence.
Read saved results and reuse gathered evidence across both tools.
detail_title: Expertise your agent can put to work.
details: A sourced brief and the fuller evidence behind it.
An independent verdict for each claim, with reasoning and citations.
A common runs directory connects research and verification.
prompt: Help me choose between Deep Research and Fact Check. Use Deep Research for my open questions and Fact Check for specific claims. Read the selected tool's --help before starting.
install:
uv tool install "deep-research @ git+https://github.com/colombod/amplifier-smart-tools-research@main#subdirectory=tools/deep-research"
uv tool install "fact-check @ git+https://github.com/colombod/amplifier-smart-tools-research@main#subdirectory=tools/fact-check"
prerequisites: Python 3.12+ and uv. Each tool installs independently.
model_note: The setup guide covers evidence acquisition and model access. Saved runs remain readable without provider credentials.
